title: Cancel the WorkManager fallback job in ExactAlarmScheduler.cancel()
description: cancel() must also cancel any pending WorkManager fallback job for this dose id, not just the AlarmManager alarm, since a dose may have been scheduled via either path. Uses block/start_anchor+end_anchor instead of function+name because the file-wide name resolver treats the bare 'cancel(context, doseLogId)' call inside schedule() as an ambiguous second match for the symbol name 'cancel'.
acceptance_criteria: Still cancels the AlarmManager pending intent exactly as before
Still calls NotificationHelper.cancel(context, doseLogId) last, as before
